auditor_issues.issue: No clear indication of file size limits for uploads
auditor_issues.why: The code mentions size limits (PAPER_MAX_BYTES, REPORT_MAX_BYTES) but this information is not clearly communicated to the user on the upload screen.
auditor_issues.fix: Display file size limits next to each file slot or in a tooltip.

auditor_issues.issue: Unclear purpose of 'What this session covers' scope list
auditor_issues.why: The purpose of this list is not explicitly stated, potentially causing confusion for first-time users.
auditor_issues.fix: Add a brief description or tooltip explaining the purpose of this list.

auditor_issues.issue: Color legend for highlight categories is not explicitly explained
auditor_issues.why: While the legend is present, its purpose and the meaning of each color/category might not be immediately clear to all users.
auditor_issues.fix: Add a tooltip or brief description to the color legend explaining each category.

auditor_issues.issue: Non-colour cues for highlight categories may not be sufficient for all users
auditor_issues.why: Some users might still struggle to distinguish between categories based solely on underline patterns.
auditor_issues.fix: Consider adding additional cues, such as icons or abbreviations, to further differentiate categories.

auditor_issues.issue: Journal readiness score cards lack clear explanations
auditor_issues.why: The scores and categories (Q1-like, Q2-like, IEEE-oriented) may not be immediately understandable to all users.
auditor_issues.fix: Provide tooltips or a brief guide explaining the scoring system and categories.

auditor_issues.issue: Export menu options could be more descriptive
auditor_issues.why: Options like 'change log txt' and 'watermarked PDF' might not be self-explanatory to all users.
auditor_issues.fix: Add brief descriptions or tooltips to explain the purpose and content of each export option.

auditor_issues.issue: 'Apply all fixes' button lacks confirmation prompt
auditor_issues.why: Automatically applying fixes without user confirmation could lead to unintended changes.
auditor_issues.fix: Add a confirmation prompt before applying all fixes.

auditor_issues.issue: No clear indication of what 'Start over' will reset
auditor_issues.why: Users might not understand what specific data or progress will be lost when starting over.
auditor_issues.fix: Provide a clear description of what starting over entails, ideally in a confirmation prompt.

auditor_issues.issue: Filter chips in FindingsQueue lack tooltips
auditor_issues.why: The purpose of each filter chip (e.g., Citations, Similarity) might not be immediately clear.
auditor_issues.fix: Add tooltips to explain the purpose of each filter chip.

auditor_issues.issue: 'Show reviewed' and 'Show informational' toggles lack clear explanations
auditor_issues.why: The distinction between reviewed and informational findings might not be clear to all users.
auditor_issues.fix: Add tooltips or brief descriptions to explain the difference between these two types of findings.

auditor_issues.issue: Privacy banner countdown lacks clear explanation of what will happen at timeout
auditor_issues.why: Users might not understand what data will be lost or what actions will be taken when the session times out.
auditor_issues.fix: Provide a clear description of what happens when the session times out, ideally with an option to extend the session.

auditor_issues.issue: Legal footer attributions and disclaimers may be too lengthy and dense
auditor_issues.why: The extensive legal text might overwhelm users and make it difficult to find relevant information.
auditor_issues.fix: Consider summarizing key points or providing a link to a separate page with full legal details.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Understanding the purpose of the 'Analyze' button

first_time_user_confusions.fix: Add a brief description or tooltip explaining the purpose of the 'Analyze' button and what happens next.
